title: Provenance envelope
description: Captured at ingest for every document. Everything the provenance metric family is computed from lives here; if a connector does not capture it, it is lost.

doc_hash.description: SHA-256 of the original bytes, before any parsing.

source_system.description: Originating system or collection channel, e.g. s3, sharepoint, mailbox, cds-transfer.

source_locator.description: Path, URI, message id or object key inside the source system.

source_id.description: Stable identifier the source assigns, if any.

collected_at.description: When the source says the document was collected or created. Absent = unknown, and that absence is itself a metric.

custody.description: Ordered chain of custody hops the source exposes.

markings.description: Markings found on the document as delivered (banner, portion marks, metadata). Raw strings; parsing is a later stage.

parent_hash.description: For attachments and container members: the document this was extracted from.

path.description: e.g. text, ocr, asr — which extraction path was taken.

reliability.description: Source rating, NATO STANAG 2511 style, when the source supplies one.
